annotations.title: Get Staff Delisting Determinations and Hearing Deadlines (Market-wide)

description: Market-wide list of open Staff Delisting Determinations that US-listed companies disclosed in SEC filings in the last `days` (default 90), with each one's facts: reason, the computed hearing request deadline (determination letter date the filing states plus 7 calendar days, Nasdaq Rule 5815(a)(1)), whether a hearing request stays the suspension, the company's stated hearing intent vs a reported request, and any stated suspension date. It answers questions such as which stocks have a delisting hearing deadline this week. hearingDeadlineWithinDays keeps only deadlines in the next N days (soonest first); rows with no computed deadline are excluded and counted in deadlineNotMeasured, so an empty result is not "none due". hearingRequestDeadlinePassed is null when not measured. A determination is not a delisting.

days.description: Look-back window on the filing date, in days (default 90, max 365).

hearingDeadlineWithinDays.description: Only determinations whose computed hearing request deadline is within the next N days (0 = today).

includePassed.description: With hearingDeadlineWithinDays, also keep deadlines that already passed (default false).
